name: AEG Turbine Factory
scope: The surviving Behrens and Bernhard AEG Turbine Hall including its attached low west aisle and 1939–40 north extension in Berlin-Moabit.
era: Standing hall with late extension, as photographed from the Huttenstraße and Berlichingenstraße corner.

originalReview.notes: Exact Qualla 2014 own-work street photo showing the distinguished south polygonal gable, rounded and coursed concrete corner, olive-green edge steel, and east window walls.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with the exact cleared Qualla original, matched to the photographer’s first and current CC0 upload. Berlin’s heritage record supplied the north extension and low aisle history.
